entries.name: NOTION_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.description: The secret of a Notion internal connection the connector reads data sources and pages with. Give the connection only the Read content capability, no user information, and share only the databases to sync with it. Notion's API can't report a connection's capabilities, so the connector can't check them; it only sends its own reads.
howToGet: Signed in to Notion as a workspace owner, open the integrations dashboard and create a new internal connection named KaratOS.
Under Capabilities, tick only Read content, and choose No user information.
In Notion, open each database to sync, choose Connections from its menu, and add KaratOS.
Copy the connection's secret straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: NOTION_DATA_SOURCE_IDS
entries.description: The ids of the Notion data sources to read, separated by commas. Unset reads every data source shared with the connection.
howToGet: Open the database in Notion, choose Manage data sources from its menu, and copy the data source's id.
